title: PowerToys Power Display module does not detect LG monitor as a brightness-controllable display in a multi-monitor setup.
summary: An LG display is detected but absent from Power Display brightness controls.

judgment.rationale: The report includes a diagnostic ZIP and a working Twinkle Tray comparison, but the model and connection path needed to match hardware are missing.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter says both displays are detected but the LG display is absent from brightness controls; another display works.
The LG display is identified as Generic PnP and Twinkle Tray reportedly adjusts it. A bug report ZIP is supplied.
DdcCiController derives brightness capability from VCP support; the failure stage has not been established.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the LG model and connection path, then reproduce brightness discovery on comparable hardware.

fix_assessment.rationale: A brightness discovery correction is plausible but must be scoped to the confirmed failure on comparable hardware.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate LG brightness capability discovery
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: brightness capability or control discovery differs for the affected LG display; the failing path is not yet known.
plan: Use the supplied report and identify the exact model, cable and DDC/CI setting.
Compare display enumeration, VCP capabilities and brightness reads with the working comparison application.
Correct the demonstrated discovery or read failure without exposing unsupported controls as functional.
Add focused coverage for the confirmed capability response and failure recovery.
verification: The affected monitor appears with working brightness control when supported.
Unsupported displays and other detected monitors remain correctly represented.

confidence.rationale: The symptom and comparison are useful, but the hardware path and failing detection stage remain unknown.

issue_context.summary: An LG display is detected but absent from Power Display brightness controls.
known_information: On 0.99.1 the reporter says both displays are detected but the LG display is absent from brightness controls; another display works.
The LG display is identified as Generic PnP and Twinkle Tray reportedly adjusts it. A bug report ZIP is supplied.
inferences: Capability detection or the hardware communication path may differ from the working comparison app; neither is proven.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/PowerDisplay/PowerDisplay.Lib/Drivers/DDC/DdcCiController.cs and Models/Monitor.cs: VCP brightness support contributes a capability flag used by the UI.
Reviewed complete thread and no assignee or timeline fix; the supplied diagnostic archive was not independently analyzed.
Searched open upstream PRs for brightness monitor work and this issue number without establishing a covering fix.
issue_context.analysis: Request only the missing hardware model and connection details; the supplied report already has a diagnostic archive and working-app comparison.

information_gaps.information: Exact LG monitor model, connection route including cable, dock or adapter, and whether DDC/CI is enabled in the monitor menu.
information_gaps.why_needed: Lets maintainers reproduce the hardware communication path and compare discovery with the working application.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the LG model and connection route, and the monitor’s DDC/CI setting if available.

comment.body:
Thanks for the report and the ZIP. You mentioned that Twinkle Tray can adjust this LG display while Power Display does not list it. Could you share:
- The exact LG model and connection route, including the cable and any dock or adapter?
- Whether DDC/CI is enabled in the monitor's on-screen menu, if that setting is available?

This will help reproduce the same discovery path.
